title: The Shoe That Never Touches Sand

collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — BEYOND THE HORIZON, EVENTS 081 to 130 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more speculative branching events continuing "Isola — Beyond the Horizon" (001-080), in the same format: EVENT nnn — TITLE, SETUP, choices A/B/C, two mutually exclusive outcomes per choice, and an optional "Content note:".

ledger.why: the owner (2026-11-15): the person the event is about is a cast villager shown by name, the role word kept as flavor (the villager need not have that job)

collection.description: Brushing sand from their feet, a villager wonders whether distant people might wear shoes all day and never feel the ground.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: Brushing sand from their feet, (name1) wonders whether distant people might wear shoes all day and never feel the ground.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The villager imagines shoes made of thick leather and wood, and wonders how anyone would climb trees.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: A builder thinks shoes might protect feet on hot, rough ground and sounds a little envious.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: An elder suggests some distant people might go barefoot just like Isolans.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: A scholar says there could be as many ways of covering feet as there are lands.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: A weaver makes a pair of thick fiber sandals, and they become popular on the rocky path.

c2__fx.name: Outcome C2
c2__fx.text: The shoes fill with sand within minutes, and everyone laughs.

c2__text.name: Outcome C2
c2__text.text: The shoes fill with sand within minutes, and everyone laughs.
